purpose: Canonical Make MCP tool and webhook workflow map for BloomX operations.

statusMeaning.connectedZeroTools: The MCP server is reachable, but Make has not exposed scenarios as MCP tools yet.
statusMeaning.allToolsPresent: The Make MCP toolbox can be used by clients to call BloomX scenarios.

recommendedModules: Webhooks / Custom webhook
Google Sheets or Notion / Create review row
Gmail / Notify reviewer
Optional Router / KYC priority routing
successCriteria: New seller application appears in the review queue.

recommendedModules: Webhooks / Custom webhook
Notion or Google Sheets / Create ticket
Gmail / Notify support team
Router / Route by data.issueType and data.priority
successCriteria: Support ticket is recorded in the operations tracker.
Admin review panel can move the ticket to reviewing or resolved.

recommendedModules: Webhooks / Custom webhook
Google Sheets / Append finance ledger row
Gmail / Send payment receipt
Optional Accounting system / Create revenue record
successCriteria: Successful payment is captured in finance ledger.

recommendedModules: Webhooks / Custom webhook
Google Sheets / Write monthly settlement report
Gmail / Send finance summary
Optional Router / Segment by seller or settlement status
successCriteria: Monthly report is generated on the first day of each month.
Pending settlement records are visible for finance review.
Finance can mark settlement records as paid after verification.

recommendedModules: Webhooks / Custom webhook
Router / Branch by failed call count
Gmail or Slack / Alert platform operations
Optional HTTP / Call admin remediation endpoint
successCriteria: Platform receives alert when failed calls cross the threshold.
Operations can identify failing seller APIs quickly.
Repeated failures can be reviewed before delisting.
